summary: @nebula.js/sn-layout-container 4.4.1 executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime at preinstall
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, marks it executable, and invokes it to execute a sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle using string-array rotation and a custom base64-alphabet decoder, with randomized identifiers; its contents are not referenced by the package's declared main entry (dist/sn-layout-container.js) and are unrelated to a Qlik nebula visualization component. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape — fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute a bundled opaque payload — evades Node-based inspection and runs automatically on npm install without user consent. The behavior is grafted onto an otherwise legitimate Qlik nebula.js visualization package and is consistent with a trojanized release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
